claim: SAKIKO is a pipeline for correction verification and licensing of pre-execution tool-decision errors
strongest_wording: a structured pipeline that couples selective correction with destination-resolved verification and evidence-graded licensing
prohibited: a new activation steering method; a novel gating mechanism

claim: A meaningful subset of tool-decision errors can be selectively improved
evidence: Phi Net +55; Qwen3-8B +38; Qwen3-4B +37 gold; Gemma +17 gold; MetaTool 15/15 arm-runs positive
strongest_wording: a meaningful subset of pre-execution tool-decision errors can be behaviourally improved by channel-specific intervention across multiple model families and scales
prohibited: controlled scaling study; SAKIKO reliably fixes tool errors across models

claim: Correction breadth extends to a second benchmark and action space
strongest_wording: both tool over-calling and under-calling improved in 5/5 runs on disjoint channel populations spanning two partially overlapping splits
prohibited: five replications on one population; exact additivity as independent evidence; any Correctable or licensing claim in binary space

evidence: REAL +55 vs RANDOM +14 REVERSE +14 WRONG_LAYER +3 MISMATCHED -17
strongest_wording: the real intervention ranks first against four corrupted variants in a five-condition reduced calibration
prohibited: a nine-condition ladder; pooling UNGATED into the five-condition table

claim: Zero of 59 matched randoms exceed real
evidence: verified independently Qwen3-8B (38 vs max 8) and Gemma (17 vs max 0)
strongest_wording: no matched-norm random direction reached the real direction's gold arrivals in either model (0/59 each)
prohibited: random directions produced no gold arrivals (false: 8 and 126 in other settings)

evidence: Phi Net +55 with 52/93 exposed-correct broken; every realization above budget
strongest_wording: aggregate improvement coexists with majority damage to the exposed baseline-correct population; the point estimate varies across executions (Broke 16-52) but every artifact-backed realization exceeds the 5% budget, the thinnest margin being 6.1% at tau=0.9
prohibited: 52/93 as a stable constant; at least a factor of 1.6; 52/264 as the collateral rate; Broke=16 as improved preservation

claim: Similar aggregate gain conceals different destination composition
evidence: Qwen3-8B activation vs score-space: Net +38/+35 gold 38/37 but OTHER_WRONG 14/21 target-hit 0.7308/0.6379
strongest_wording: two interventions with similar aggregate improvement produced substantially different observed destination compositions
prohibited: activation is statistically superior; score-space is inferior; 0/6 vs 2/6 as strong preservation evidence

claim: Router gating controls exposure volume not sample safety
evidence: Cliff delta -0.094 p 0.44; break rate 55.9%->51.0% across tau
strongest_wording: Router gating controls how many baseline-correct samples are exposed, not which are safe, in this setting
prohibited: generalisation beyond Phi/W2C; that a new threshold was validated

claim: Correction strength is protocol-conditional and evidence-graded; the frozen gate admits one and declines two modern models
evidence: Qwen3-8B FORMAL_CONFIRMATORY_SUCCESS; Qwen3-4B and Gemma FORMAL_DECLINE on destination-interval conditions; exit-matched destination differences flip sign
strongest_wording: under the prospectively frozen gate one modern model was admitted and two were declined on the destination-interval conditions, and the historical Phi setting is Steerable with preservation failure; these four settings are row-level verified. Llama and Mistral are reported as SUPPORTING breadth from secondary audit records, not as load-bearing content. Rung placement is conditional on model x dataset x channel x protocol x dose and, because the dose rule selects the smallest admissible dose, is conservative
prohibited: intrinsic model correctability; model X is more correctable than model Y; margin explains rung placement

claim: The evidence requirement scales steeply with effect size
strongest_wording: certifying majority repair requires exit counts that grow steeply as the true target-hit approaches 0.50
prohibited: any application of this curve to papers not measuring the Level-2 estimand

claim: Mechanism: correction quality is a design property
evidence: gating; estimator; site; dose; stability; multi-PC; Jaccard 1.000
strongest_wording: tool-decision errors correspond to structured partially overlapping decision-associated representations; effective intervention depends on estimator, channel matching, site, gating in many settings, and dose; representation geometry alone does not determine finite-dose destination
prohibited: causal circuit; channel orthogonality; universal gating necessity; margin as mechanism

claim: The hierarchy also rejects: two historical models fail direction-specificity
evidence: Llama 5/20 and 3/20 randoms >= real; Mistral 17/20 and reverse +19 > real +12
strongest_wording: two historical models failed the specificity rung, showing the ladder rejects as well as admits
prohibited: any row-level destination claim for these models - records are secondary-audit only (Tier C)
